common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-intent pixel-art game character base sprite. Create a genuinely appealing ORIGINAL cute elderly grandmother shooting a gun, full body, 3/4 side view facing RIGHT, natural expressive action stance. Hand-crafted premium 16-bit indie pixel art with coherent deliberate pixel clusters and selective dark plum 1-pixel contour, hue-shifted 3-tone shading, warm charming expressive aged face. IMPORTANT resolution: design on an exact 64 by 64 LOGICAL PIXEL canvas, then display at a clean integer enlargement, every logical pixel is a flat square, aligned uniform grid, no subpixel details. Entire character + weapon + small muzzle flash fit with 3-4 logical pixels transparent margin. Character head about 18 logical pixels wide, full figure about 51 logical pixels high; design must read at actual 64x64. 2.4-2.7 head adult chibi proportions, not a baby. Beautiful large readable clothing shapes, distinct silhouette, lively asymmetric pose, rich but restrained 20-28 opaque color palette, clean readable hands touching the gun. Transparent background with actual alpha, no ground shadow, no stage, no border, no text, no labels, no collage, ONE character only. Avoid photorealism, smooth illustration, high-resolution line art, huge black square eyeglasses, perfectly frontal rigid paper-doll stance, tiny noisy textures, blurry edges, gradient shading and dithering.

candidates.name: grandma_04_sundeok
candidates.title: 순덕 할매
candidates.direction: A cheeky Korean country grandmother, age 75, short stout pear-shaped body, energetic forward lean. Distinctive soft fluffy charcoal-and-silver perm hair in large curled clusters, tiny round low-set spectacles that do not cover her expressive brows, one confident squint and a crooked warm grin, plump peach cheeks. Mustard quilted vest over dusty-rose sleeves, dark burgundy roomy trousers with just two tiny coral flower clusters, practical maroon shoes. She braces a chunky walnut-and-blue-steel pump-action shotgun firing to the RIGHT with BOTH hands, stock at shoulder and one hand underneath barrel. Tiny warm muzzle star. Her comedy is that she looks like a cozy neighborhood grandma but stands like an action hero. Strong diagonal gesture, good visible neck and waist, no rectangular bobblehead.

Original friendly storybook forest adventurer; not any existing named character.
